limits: SYNTHETIC only: no real-report accuracy or cross-institution generalization is assessed.
Genes are counted separately and cannot fill the 125 laboratory targets.
Legacy scope is restricted to the exact frozen v1 bytes and definitions; Phase Two context fixtures are unassessed there.
No clinical default reference range, conversion formula or derived medical result is supplied.

Normal routing is assessed only on 98 frozen parser controls with explicit specimen and reviewed units; it is not a full clinical-quality or trend-admission claim. Legacy scope leaves these controls unassessed.
Public synthetic data only. Values are arbitrary arithmetic inputs, not clinical thresholds, patient measurements, or clinical normal/abnormal labels.

Dates, patient groups and methods are frozen evaluation context supplied to the real comparison/validation code. Metadata extraction and persistence are not assessed here; report_date field accuracy is unassessed.
Ordinary parser cases have separate synthetic patients. Only the explicitly grouped history cases share a synthetic patient.

No rule parameters are used to create OCR input, source truth, dates, methods, patients or expected outputs. Rule applicability/trigger counts describe execution on these cases, not independent clinical validation of rule parameters.
Private real-source evaluation remains optional and is never needed to run this public publication evaluation.
Rows count source representations, including independently retained duplicate photos/pages.
Unknown fields and unmatched rows outside explicitly complete annotation scopes are unassessed; failed files remain in full counts.
Severe count conservatively includes every verified value, unit, type or project error, including intercepted ones.
Exact localization requires independently annotated field boxes and intersection-over-union >=0.5; page fallback never qualifies.
